grammar.pattern: 需要 + 名词 / 动词短语
grammar.purpose: State a need without turning it into consent
grammar.explanation: 活动需要两个人 states a staffing need; 我需要休息 states a personal need. 需要 is not a volunteer’s promise. 不需要 contrasts absence of need with 不愿意, lack of willingness. Questions like 需要我帮忙吗？ offer help and still await an answer. State quantity and task scope, not a blanket requirement to obey.

examples.py: huó dòng xū yào liǎng gè rén .
xū yào wǒ bān yǐ zi ma ?
examples.en: Do you need me to move chairs?

examples.py: wǒ xū yào xiān kàn rèn wù nèi róng .
examples.en: I need to see the task description first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 需要两个人，所以你已经答应了。
commonMistakes.right: 需要两个人，还要问你愿不愿意。
commonMistakes.why: A need does not establish another person’s agreement.

grammar.pattern: 各 / 各位 / 各种 / 每 / 任何
grammar.purpose: Read distribution and the bounds of a general claim
grammar.explanation: 各组 distributes work by group; 每个人 by individual. 各位 politely addresses those present, not the whole world. 各种 names different kinds, not necessarily every possible type. 任何人都可以询问 uses any within the stated context; 任何人都不 may deny permission to everyone in that context. Always recover what set the statement concerns.

examples.py: gè zǔ xiān què rèn shí jiān .
examples.en: Each group confirms the time first.

examples.py: měi wèi duì yuán bān liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
examples.en: Each team member moves two chairs.

examples.zh: 任何人都可以先问内容。
examples.py: rèn hé rén dōu kě yǐ xiān wèn nèi róng .
examples.en: Anyone may first ask about the task.

commonMistakes.wrong: 每组两个人，就是每个人两组。
commonMistakes.right: 每组两个人，是一组有两个人。
commonMistakes.why: Do not reverse the distributed unit and the counted members.

lines.zh: 周六活动需要两位志愿者，你能来吗？
lines.py: zhōu liù huó dòng xū yào liǎng wèi zhì yuàn zhě , nǐ néng lái ma ?
lines.en: We need two volunteers for Saturday's event. Can you come?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 能，我两点到，三点要走。
lines.py: néng , wǒ liǎng diǎn dào , sān diǎn yào zǒu .
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrive at two and need to leave at three.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 正好。两点到三点你负责名单，我负责入口。
lines.py: zhèng hǎo . liǎng diǎn dào sān diǎn nǐ fù zé míng dān , wǒ fù zé rù kǒu .
lines.en: That works. You handle the list from two to three; I'll handle the entrance.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 名单放在哪里？
lines.py: míng dān fàng zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: Where's the list?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 放在门口那张桌子上。我会提前拿过去。
lines.py: fàng zài mén kǒu nà zhāng zhuō zi shàng . wǒ huì tí qián ná guò qù .
lines.en: On the table by the entrance. I'll bring it over beforehand.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 还需要搬椅子吗？
lines.py: hái xū yào bān yǐ zi ma ?
lines.en: Do we need to move chairs too?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 需要。这里共有四把，每人搬两把就行。
lines.py: xū yào . zhè lǐ gòng yǒu sì bǎ , měi rén bān liǎng bǎ jiù xíng .
lines.en: Yes. There are four here. We can move two each.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，搬到窗户旁边？
lines.py: xíng , bān dào chuāng hù páng biān ?
lines.en: Okay, beside the window?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对。有人想坐着等朋友，放那里比较方便。
lines.py: duì . yǒu rén xiǎng zuò zhe děng péng you , fàng nà lǐ bǐ jiào fāng biàn .
lines.en: Yes. People may want to sit while waiting for friends; that's a convenient spot.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我到的时候先搬。
lines.py: nà wǒ dào de shí hou xiān bān .
lines.en: I'll move them when I arrive, then.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 谢谢，三点以后小周来接你的班。
lines.py: xiè xiè , sān diǎn yǐ hòu xiǎo zhōu lái jiē nǐ de bān .
lines.en: Thanks. Xiao Zhou will take over from you after three.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，那我把名单直接交给她。
lines.py: hǎo , nà wǒ bǎ míng dān zhí jiē jiāo gěi tā .
lines.en: Good. I'll give her the list directly.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A work note with boundaries
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周六我去帮读书小组办活动，两点到门口时，陈宇已经把名单放在桌子上了。我三点要走，所以我们先说好交接的时间。
lines.py: zhōu liù wǒ qù bāng dú shū xiǎo zǔ bàn huó dòng , liǎng diǎn dào mén kǒu shí , chén yǔ yǐ jīng bǎ míng dān fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le . wǒ sān diǎn yào zǒu , suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān shuō hǎo jiāo jiē de shí jiān .
lines.en: I helped with the reading group's event on Saturday. When I arrived at two, Chen Yu had put the list on the table. I needed to leave at three, so we agreed on the handover time first.

lines.zh: 门边共有四把椅子，我们每人搬两把，放到窗户旁边。刚搬好，就有两位朋友坐下来等人。
lines.py: mén biān gòng yǒu sì bǎ yǐ zi , wǒ men měi rén bān liǎng bǎ , fàng dào chuāng hù páng biān . gāng bān hǎo , jiù yǒu liǎng wèi péng you zuò xià lái děng rén .
lines.en: There were four chairs by the door. We moved two each to the window. As soon as they were in place, two friends sat down to wait for someone.

lines.zh: 我负责名单，陈宇负责入口。有人问房间在哪里，他就指给对方看；有人要登记，我就请对方到桌子前面来。
lines.py: wǒ fù zé míng dān , chén yǔ fù zé rù kǒu . yǒu rén wèn fáng jiān zài nǎ lǐ , tā jiù zhǐ gěi duì fāng kàn ; yǒu rén yào dēng jì , wǒ jiù qǐng duì fāng dào zhuō zi qián miàn lái .
lines.en: I handled the list, and Chen Yu handled the entrance. He showed people where the room was; I invited anyone registering to the table.

lines.zh: 一位新朋友没带书，我问陈宇还有没有。他从包里拿出一本，放到桌上，让朋友先选一段看。
lines.py: yī wèi xīn péng you méi dài shū , wǒ wèn chén yǔ hái yǒu méi yǒu . tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī běn , fàng dào zhuō shàng , ràng péng you xiān xuǎn yī duàn kàn .
lines.en: A newcomer hadn't brought a book. I asked Chen Yu if there were any left. He took one from his bag and let the visitor choose a section.

lines.zh: 快三点时，小周到了。我把名单给她，又告诉她那本借来的书是谁在看。她拿笔记了下来，我才去拿自己的包。
lines.py: kuài sān diǎn shí , xiǎo zhōu dào le . wǒ bǎ míng dān gěi tā , yòu gào sù tā nà běn jiè lái de shū shì shéi zài kàn . tā ná bǐ jì le xià lái , wǒ cái qù ná zì jǐ de bāo .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou arrived just before three. I gave her the list and told her who had the borrowed book. She wrote it down, and I went to get my bag.

lines.zh: 走到门口，陈宇还问我下次来不来。我说来，下次如果有时间，可以多留一会儿。他笑着说先去忙今天的事吧。
lines.py: zǒu dào mén kǒu , chén yǔ hái wèn wǒ xià cì lái bù lái . wǒ shuō lái , xià cì rú guǒ yǒu shí jiān , kě yǐ duō liú yī huì er . tā xiào zhe shuō xiān qù máng jīn tiān de shì ba .
lines.en: At the entrance Chen Yu asked if I'd come again. I would, and might stay longer if I had time next time. He smiled and told me to get on with today's plans first.

lines.py: nǐ gāng cái bān le jǐ bǎ yǐ zi ?

lines.speaker: a

lines.py: liǎng bǎ , zěn me le ?

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我也搬两把，可这里怎么有五把？
lines.py: wǒ yě bān liǎng bǎ , kě zhè lǐ zěn me yǒu wǔ bǎ ?

lines.py: dì wǔ bǎ shì lǎo wáng zì jǐ ná guò lái de .
lines.en: Lao Wang brought the fifth one himself.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怪不得。他已经坐上去了。
lines.py: guài bu de . tā yǐ jīng zuò shàng qù le .
lines.en: No wonder. He's already sitting on it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那不用搬了，连人一起搬太重。
lines.py: nà bù yòng bān le , lián rén yì qǐ bān tài zhòng .
lines.en: Then leave it. Moving him with it would be too heavy.

lines.en: There is more demand for transport at weekends.

lines.zh: 他的志愿是成为一名老师。
lines.py: tā de zhì yuàn shì chéng wéi yī míng lǎo shī .
lines.en: His aspiration is to become a teacher.

lines.zh: 她根据自己的兴趣填报了志愿。
lines.py: tā gēn jù zì jǐ de xìng qù tián bào le zhì yuàn .
lines.en: She submitted her course choices based on her interests.

lines.zh: 两位志愿者在门口发地图。
lines.py: liǎng wèi zhì yuàn zhě zài mén kǒu fā dì tú .
lines.en: Two volunteers are handing out maps at the entrance.

lines.zh: 我周六当了半天志愿者。
lines.py: wǒ zhōu liù dāng le bàn tiān zhì yuàn zhě .
lines.en: I volunteered for half a day on Saturday.

lines.zh: 读者给作者写了一封信。
lines.py: dú zhě gěi zuò zhě xiě le yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: A reader wrote the author a letter.

lines.zh: 参加者请带一瓶水。
lines.py: cān jiā zhě qǐng dài yī píng shuǐ .
lines.en: Participants should bring a bottle of water.

lines.zh: 服务员拿来了一壶茶。
lines.py: fú wù yuán ná lái le yī hú chá .
lines.en: The waiter brought a pot of tea.

lines.zh: 新队员今天第一次训练。
lines.py: xīn duì yuán jīn tiān dì yī cì xùn liàn .
lines.en: The new team member is training for the first time today.

lines.zh: 店里的员工都认识她。
lines.py: diàn lǐ de yuán gōng dōu rèn shi tā .
lines.en: All the staff in the shop know her.

lines.zh: 这家店有三名员工。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn yǒu sān míng yuán gōng .
lines.en: There are three employees in this shop.

lines.zh: 我今天的任务是整理书架。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān de rèn wù shì zhěng lǐ shū jià .
lines.en: My task today is to organise the bookshelf.

lines.zh: 任务完成后，我们去吃饭。
lines.py: rèn wù wán chéng hòu , wǒ men qù chī fàn .
lines.en: We went for a meal after finishing the task.

lines.zh: 照看这些花是我的责任。
lines.py: zhào kàn zhè xiē huā shì wǒ de zé rèn .
lines.en: Looking after these flowers is my responsibility.

lines.zh: 她很认真地承担了自己的责任。
lines.py: tā hěn rèn zhēn de chéng dān le zì jǐ de zé rèn .
lines.en: She took her responsibility seriously.

lines.zh: 你负责名单，我负责入口。
lines.py: nǐ fù zé míng dān , wǒ fù zé rù kǒu .
lines.en: You handle the list; I'll handle the entrance.

lines.zh: 这件事由他负责。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì yóu tā fù zé .
lines.en: He's responsible for this matter.

lines.zh: 我们已经安排好周末的活动。
lines.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng ān pái hǎo zhōu mò de huó dòng .
lines.en: We've arranged the weekend's activities.

lines.zh: 这个安排对大家都方便。
lines.py: zhè gè ān pái duì dà jiā dōu fāng biàn .
lines.en: This arrangement suits everyone.

lines.zh: 老师把材料分配给各组。
lines.py: lǎo shī bǎ cái liào fēn pèi gěi gè zǔ .
lines.en: The teacher distributed the materials among the groups.

lines.zh: 这些任务怎么分配？
lines.py: zhè xiē rèn wù zěn me fēn pèi ?
lines.en: How shall we divide up these tasks?

lines.zh: 我们先分组，再讨论。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān fēn zǔ , zài tǎo lùn .
lines.en: Let's form groups before discussing.

lines.zh: 分组以后，每组选一个名字。
lines.py: fēn zǔ yǐ hòu , měi zǔ xuǎn yī gè míng zi .
lines.en: After forming groups, each group should choose a name.

lines.zh: 这是大家共同完成的集体作品。
lines.py: zhè shì dà jiā gòng tóng wán chéng de jí tǐ zuò pǐn .
lines.en: This is a collective work everyone made together.

lines.zh: 她很喜欢这个集体。
lines.py: tā hěn xǐ huān zhè gè jí tǐ .
lines.en: She really likes being part of this group.

lines.zh: 我们有一个共同的朋友。
lines.py: wǒ men yǒu yī gè gòng tóng de péng you .
lines.en: We have a mutual friend.

lines.zh: 这件事需要共同商量。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì xū yào gòng tóng shāng liáng .
lines.en: We need to discuss this together.

lines.zh: 这里共有四把椅子。
lines.py: zhè lǐ gòng yǒu sì bǎ yǐ zi .
lines.en: There are four chairs here in all.

lines.zh: 我们共有两天时间。
lines.py: wǒ men gòng yǒu liǎng tiān shí jiān .
lines.en: We have two days in total.

lines.zh: 我们第一次合作就很顺利。
lines.py: wǒ men dì yī cì hé zuò jiù hěn shùn lì .
lines.en: Our first collaboration went smoothly.

lines.zh: 两家书店准备合作办活动。
lines.py: liǎng jiā shū diàn zhǔn bèi hé zuò bàn huó dòng .
lines.en: The two bookshops plan to organise an event together.

lines.zh: 她积极参加学校的活动。
lines.py: tā jī jí cān jiā xué xiào de huó dòng .
lines.en: She takes an active part in school activities.

lines.zh: 大家都很积极，很快就分好了组。
lines.py: dà jiā dōu hěn jī jí , hěn kuài jiù fēn hǎo le zǔ .
lines.en: Everyone was enthusiastic and the groups formed quickly.

lines.zh: 我支持你的想法。
lines.py: wǒ zhī chí nǐ de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: I support your idea.

lines.zh: 家人的支持让她更有信心。
lines.py: jiā rén de zhī chí ràng tā gèng yǒu xìn xīn .
lines.en: Her family's support gave her more confidence.

lines.zh: 他主动帮我搬东西。
lines.py: tā zhǔ dòng bāng wǒ bān dōng xi .
lines.en: He offered to help me move things.

lines.zh: 有问题，我会主动联系你。
lines.py: yǒu wèn tí , wǒ huì zhǔ dòng lián xì nǐ .
lines.en: I'll contact you myself if there's a problem.

lines.zh: 这个团体每周见面一次。
lines.py: zhè gè tuán tǐ měi zhōu jiàn miàn yī cì .
lines.en: This group meets once a week.

lines.zh: 三个团体共同举办了这次活动。
lines.py: sān gè tuán tǐ gòng tóng jǔ bàn le zhè cì huó dòng .
lines.en: Three organisations held this event together.

lines.zh: 所有队员都到齐了。
lines.py: suǒ yǒu duì yuán dōu dào qí le .
lines.en: All the team members have arrived.

lines.zh: 她是队里最年轻的队员。
lines.py: tā shì duì lǐ zuì nián qīng de duì yuán .
lines.en: She's the youngest member of the team.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三04, 三08. Native check: 需要 versus obligation and consent; 志愿 noun use; suffixes 者/员 in connected words; 每/各/任何 scope; 共有 versus 共同; collective-work collocations and original chair joke. No real employment or volunteering arrangement is created. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 二48 / 二54 / 三01 / 三02: 姐姐是商人，我是学生。, 今天星期三，这本书三十五块。, 老李是称呼，不能直接猜他的年龄。, 朋友们看包里头的书，桌子上的笔先别动。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Early HSK 3 correction: warm introductions at a reading group, a hesitant reader taking a first turn, a one-hour volunteer handover and friends helping with messages and copying. Removed relationship-inference, unlimited-consent and assessment-policy cautions from ordinary speech. All 22 target records have two independent authored contexts, including formal or bound forms outside the casual scene. Preserved all old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: 老王 and 小李 forms of address; bound 者/员 and 志愿 application sense; 怕是 cautious prediction; colloquial 留个位子/接班 and quiet cat/chair teasing; 没收到 méi shōu dào rather than 没收 mò shōu; warmth versus familiarity in 亲切; 亲 as blood relation or closeness. Check every factual key against its own heard line. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
